# Mac.apk Compatibility Capabilities Registry

<!-- Generated by scripts/cap_registry.py render-md from docs/compat/capabilities.json -->

## 1. Research Anchor & SDK Presentation Policy

- **AOSP Reference Anchor**: Android 16 / API 36 (`android-16.0.0_r2`). Used solely as the reference contract anchor for new entries, **not** a claim of full API 36 completeness.
- **`android-api.idx.gz` Gap**: ApiIndexLoader reads classpath resource /android-api.idx.gz generated by tools/api-index/gen.py (~5,000 API 36 classes); neither the generator nor android-api.idx.gz is present in this repo or runtime/build/lib/android-framework.jar, leaving upstream AOSP denominator unknown until supplied.
- **Presented SDK Policy (`PresentedSdk` / `Build`)**:
  - `DEFAULT_SDK = 29`, `FLOOR = 29`, `CEILING = 36`, `MAX_KNOWN_SDK = 37`.
  - `MACAPK_SDK_FROM_TARGET`: default `True` (clamps app `targetSdkVersion` to `[29, 36]`, falls back to `29` if manifest unreadable or disabled with `=0`).
  - Overrides: `MACAPK_SDK_FROM_TARGET=0|1, MACAPK_SDK_INT=<1..10000>, MACAPK_SDK_CEILING=<29..37>`.
  - Unverified preview constant: `Build.VERSION_CODES.CINNAMON_BUN (37, unverified preview constant; VERSION_CODES_FULL stops at BAKLAVA = 3600000)` (kept for reflective lookups; awaiting finalized AOSP branch).
